about: Sound golden, dry: the resonator bank before any effect. The C++ SkySound replays the chord requests at their ticks and must match the notes, the RMS and the sample windows. Until T3.8 it came from the T1.3 sketch (prototype/sky/export-sound-golden.mjs); since T3.8 (the band edges replace the sketch's fixed layer ranges) the notes, RMS and windows are SkySound's own at the default bands, re-exported by WorldtableTests "[.regen-sound-golden]"; the requests and onsets are still the sketch's.
